system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Enriching the behavior of LLM with highly dynamic prompt construction mechanisms;
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt classes in ailice/prompts/ not opened; README describes per-round prompt generation from dialogue history.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It serves as an all-encompassing coder and a proficient system management tool, mastering all system commands
env_context_strategy.note: Paper (2025, kragent.ai) mentions injecting file lists; not verified for v0.2.0.

context_compaction.note: AConversation.py / prompt classes not in bundle; contextWindowRatio caps prompt length but mechanism not shown. Paper describes CONTEXT-COMPRESS for later system.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Representing input, output, programs, and data in text form.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We can use regular expressions to express a carefully designed grammatical structure, parse it into a function call and execute it.
tool_call_format.note: Closest value: regex-parsed text syntax (ARegex.py), not native function calling ('we bypass openai's function calling mechanism').

tool_count.note: Prompt/tool registry files (APromptMain.py, ATools.py) not in bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Tool definitions not in bundle; edits appear to go through script execution (AScripter).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The system dynamically retrieves function lists and documentation from these modules to inject into the context as prompts.
tool_schema_source.note: Describes later kragent.ai; v0.2.0 module code not opened.

protocol_standardization.note: No grep over source possible; custom lightRPC used for modules.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: inside AProcessor, the calculation is alternately completed by LLM and the interpreter, their outputs are each other's inputs, forming a cycle.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: user-input text commands are executed as a kind of program, decomposed into various "subprograms", and addressed by different agents
planning_granularity.note: Decomposition via sub-agent calls, no plan object evidenced.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: each agent can create and call more sub-agents, and can also dialogue with its caller to obtain supplementary information or report its progress
multi_agent_topology.note: Default 'main' prompt decides which agent type to call; recursive call tree.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Proxy_cat_gallery then creates another agent, researcher_api, and employs it to address the issue.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: when AIlice requires additional information, it will seek input from you
human_in_loop.note: Closest value: user is an agent queried by escalation and reviews replies; no per-action approval evidenced.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The interior of AProcessor is a multi-round dialogue.

long_term_memory.note: ChromaDB storage service; cross-run persistence not verified.

state_persistence.note: Main loop files not in bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: LLM finally gets the answer and responds to the external caller, ending this call.
termination_condition.note: README: 'AIlice currently lacks a run time control mechanism'.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: AIlice currently lacks a run time control mechanism, so she might get stuck in a loop or run for an extended period.
cost_controls.note: Config model AConfig.py has no budget field.

timeouts.evidence_quote: AIlice currently lacks a run time control mechanism
timeouts.note: Per-tool timeouts in AScripter not verifiable; run-level absence stated.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: by default, code execution utilizes the local environment
execution_isolation.note: Docker container opt-in via services.scripter config.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: by default, code execution utilizes the local environment. To prevent potential AI errors leading to irreversible losses, it is recommended to install Docker

network_policy.note: Config model has no network option; browser/google services shipped.

tracing.evidence_quote: --**trace** is used to specify the output directory for the execution history data.
tracing.note: Off by default; format not verified.

eval_hooks.note: Listed as roadmap; file tree has no eval runner.

target_domain.evidence_quote: performing various complex tasks from local data analysis to information investigations on the internet

open_source.note: LICENSE file present but text not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Designed for open-source models but seamlessly supports commercial models like GPT-4.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The prototype (AIlice) was open-sourced in 2023 at https://github.com/myshell-ai/AIlice.
